snapshot.title: Comprehensive Independent System Audit (Security, Performance & Code Quality)
snapshot.description: A meticulous, independent audit to identify security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, code inefficiencies, and data leakage risks. This follows international standards (OWASP Top 10, ISO/IEC 27001) for strict system evaluation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Security: Verify CSRF/XSS protection and input sanitization across all modules
Security: Audit authentication/session management and API authorization (BOLA check)
Security: Verify data encryption at rest/transit and scan for sensitive data in logs/responses
Security: Scan and resolve dependency vulnerabilities (npm audit)
Performance: Identify and fix database N+1 problems and missing indexes
Performance: Optimize frontend Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) and bundle size
Performance: Evaluate server-side response times and caching strategies
Code Quality: Audit architectural consistency (SOLID/DRY) and redundant code
Code Quality: Standardize error handling and logging across system
Infrastructure: Secure environment variable management and secrets
